description:
Hold the Action Button and talk. Hold it again, and your words are on the clipboard, ready to paste into any app.
Free and open source. No account, no subscription, no tracking.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Hold the Action Button. The Dynamic Island shows that the app is listening.
2. Say what you want to write.
3. Hold the Action Button again. Paste the text where you need it.

Setup takes about two minutes: add one small shortcut and put it on the Action Button. The app shows you how. No Action Button? The same shortcut works from Control Center, the Lock Screen and Back Tap. You can also try it inside the app.

YOU CHOOSE WHERE YOUR VOICE GOES
- On your iPhone. Download a speech model once. After that your voice stays on the phone and dictation works offline. No key and no account. There are two models: Parakeet V3 (494 MB, 25 European languages, with English, Ukrainian and Polish among them) and Whisper Large Turbo (632 MB, about a hundred languages).
- Your own cloud account. Paste your own API key from OpenAI (speech and writing styles) or ElevenLabs (speech). Your voice goes straight from your iPhone to that service. Any cost is between you and that service. Nobody stands in the middle.

The language is detected automatically. With a cloud service you can also set it yourself.

OPTIONAL: WRITING STYLES
- Clean removes "um" and repeated words. Casual and Formal change the tone. Custom follows your own instructions.
- Spoken instructions: start or end with "give me this in Polish" and you get the text in Polish.
Styles and spoken instructions need the cloud key that covers writing styles. Without it, you get the text exactly as you said it.

SMALL THINGS THAT HELP
- A Live Activity shows a timer while the app listens, with a button to stop.
- Your last 30 texts stay in the app, so nothing is lost if a paste goes wrong.
- A recording you forget stops by itself after 10 minutes. You can change the limit.
- If a recording cannot be turned into text, it stays on your phone and you can try again.

PRIVACY
There are no servers behind this app. It has no analytics, no ads and no tracking. Your API keys are stored in the iPhone Keychain and are sent only to the service they belong to.
Full policy: https://github.com/yadaniyil/open-dictation/blob/main/PRIVACY.md

OPEN SOURCE
The code is public under the MIT license: https://github.com/yadaniyil/open-dictation

Needs iOS 26 or later. The Action Button is on iPhone 15 Pro and most newer iPhones.
promotionalText: Hold the Action Button, talk, hold it again. Your words are on the clipboard, ready to paste. Free and open source. No account. Your voice can stay on your iPhone.
